desc:
🕷️ Welcome to Spider Rising!

Swing freely across a massive city, master fast web traversal, fight enemies, complete crimes, and unlock new suits. Test your skills against other players in an advanced PvP system, chase down dangerous villains, and become the city’s ultimate hero.

Expect frequent updates, improvements, and new content.

Inspired by Spider-Man.

📱 Mobile, PC and Console supported.

🖥️ PC Controls

M1 — Punch
Q — Uppercut
LShift — Web Swing
E — Web Shot
F — Web Pull
Left Ctrl — Dodge
C — Dive
V — ShiftLock
🎮 Console Controls

X — Punch
LT — Uppercut
RB — Web Shot
RT — Web Swing
LB — Web Zip
Y — Stealth Attack / Web Pull
D-Pad Up — Spidey Sense
B — Dive
L3 — Sprint

👍 Like and favorite the game to support development and receive future updates!
